feed.title: FlutterGuard releases
feed.subtitle: Dated release notes for the FlutterGuard Android app.

entry.title: 0.4.0 — detection release
entry.summary: Findings split into confirmed artifact facts, leads and inventory; release-to-release diffing; Dart snapshot metadata; JVM CLI with SARIF. 388 tests, no INTERNET permission, versionCode 10.

entry.title: 0.3.4 — brand pass
entry.summary: The app adopts the site's colour and type tokens. New signing key for GitHub builds, so 0.3.3 to 0.3.4 needs an uninstall. Scanning behaviour unchanged.

entry.title: 0.3.3 — smaller build with R8 and resource shrinking
entry.summary: APK 6.9 MB to 1.4 MB, AAB 3.4 MB, packed DEX reduced to a single 2.4 MB file, 282 unit tests across 38 suites, no INTERNET permission.

entry.title: 0.3.2 — consent, settings and legal documents
entry.summary: Settings and consent screens, privacy and licence pages in the app. versionCode 7; this is the build Google Play serves.

entry.title: 0.3.0 — corpus-driven detectors
entry.summary: Detector rules derived from the public release APK corpus rather than from framework documentation alone.

entry.title: 0.2.0 — the research workbench
entry.summary: Findings grouped by artifact, library, endpoint, string and policy, with JSON and Markdown reports.

entry.title: 0.1.0 — first public build
entry.summary: Installed-package and single-APK inspection, on-device analysis, no network permission.
